concepts.definition: The employer size range band reported for the WGEA submission, expressed as an employee-count band such as '<250', '250-499' or '5000+'. The band set is publisher-defined and open-ended at the top; it is a band, not an exact headcount.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents an employer headcount band; ext.financial.revenue_band is a revenue band under a named scheme and is not an employee-count band, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: The ANZSIC division name the employer reporting unit reported for its WGEA submission, e.g. 'Transport, Postal and Warehousing'. It is the publisher's division label, not a coded ANZSIC value.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.industry_code expects a coded ANZSIC value (division letter, subdivision, group or class) and is owned by business; entity.industry_code likewise expects a coded ANZSIC value for the business. This column holds a division name label for the reporting unit, so type, meaning and owner differ from both.

concepts.definition: The ANZSIC class name the employer reporting unit reported for its WGEA submission, e.g. 'Computer System Design and Related Services'. It is the publisher's class label, not a coded ANZSIC class number.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.industry_code expects a coded ANZSIC value and is owned by business; entity.industry_code likewise expects a coded ANZSIC value for the business. This column holds a class name label for the reporting unit, so type, meaning and owner differ from both.

reuse.dyn.employer_reporting_unit.reporting_na: unchanged prior draft: WGEA reporting-unit label, not a verified legal or trading name; owner employer_reporting_unit.
reuse.dyn.employer_reporting_unit.reporting_ab: unchanged prior draft: reporting-unit submission identifier, not asserted as the business legal person's ABN.
reuse.dyn.employer_reporting_unit.sector: unchanged prior draft: WGEA private/public reporting classification of the reporting unit, not a legal form or scheme-tagged activity.
